description: This file defines the Shipping model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically managing the calculation and addition of shipping costs to the cart total.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: A model class responsible for calculating and adding shipping costs to the total, including handling tax calculations based on shipping method.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates shipping costs, applies taxes, and updates the totals array, taxes array, and total cost based on current cart and session data.
